Application Insights SDK forms an integral part of Azure Monitor – providing you with the ability to collect and send telemetry data across various application components to Azure Monitor.

Today, we are announcing the release of our newest Application Insights .NET SDK version 2.15. This release is directly in response to customer feedback and introduces a new set of features and bug fixes.
 
With this update, you can take advantage of new features like: 

  • Simplified Application Insights service options configuration for ASP.NET core applications. 
  • First-class source debugging experiences for binaries through support for source links in the SDK.
  • Telemetry ingestion tracking – allowing customers to track transmitted telemetry and responses from the ingestion service in Azure. 
  • Temporary local storage of telemetry data sent through the server telemetry channel during network outages and transient errors is now on by default for Windows, Linux & Mac.

Additionally, with this release, Application Insights .NET SDK will longer support .NET Framework 4.5 and .NET Core 1.xx applications, as these .NET versions have reached end of supportability. Moving forward, we will continue to support all officially supported versions of .NET.

Details of all updates and bug fixes are available in our change logs.

Ready to Download?

The SDK is now available for public consumption and you can download the latest version of the SDK NuGet package (Latest version of the NuGet package).

To configure your ASP.NET or ASP.NET Core app to send telemetry to Azure Monitor, please follow the instructions stated in the Azure Monitor documentation webpage. 

Future Releases

As we continue to evolve and learn from this stable version, you are encouraged to provide us feedback. Our next version, v2.16, will include support for and be released on the same day as .NET 5.
